# Pre-page-view implementation

Captured from accepted Apps1.17, markup /6. Original producer, manifest, sealed bytes and page templates are retained as independent compatibility/output oracles for existing /6 graph and reference consumers. `TestAppPagesOriginalDisplayBytes` parses the captured original page directly for its independent byte oracle; retained directory lifecycle fixtures consume the original producer, manifest and bytes. Not a second default implementation. Remove when those historical consumers retire.
